# `morphir kb show`

- **Usage:** `morphir kb show <FLAGS>`

Show one document: frontmatter, outbound links, heading outline

## Flags
- **`--kb <PATH>`** — Path to the knowledge base root (the directory holding bundles/). Auto-detected when omitted
- **`--json`** — Emit JSON instead of text, for chaining and for agent consumption
- **`--path <PATH>`** — Concept path — bundle-relative (/x.md) or a path suffix
- **`--bundle <BUNDLE>`** — Bundle to resolve a bundle-relative path against
- **`--body`** — Also include the document body
